content:
I'm excited to announce lean-regex — a formally verified regular expression engine written in Lean 4!

This library supports many features familiar from regex engines in other languages, including capture groups, character classes, and substring matching. What's special is that the implementation is formally proven correct with respect to the semantics of regular expressions — making it a trustworthy tool for verified programming.

To add lean-regex to your project, include the following in your lakefile.toml:

[[require]]
name = "Regex"
git = "https://github.com/pandaman64/lean-regex"
rev = "v4.19.0"
subDir = "regex"

Feedback, bug reports, and contributions are very welcome — feel free to open an issue at https://github.com/pandaman64/lean-regex/issues
